documents.title: Orthopedic clinic visit
documents.author: S. Rehman (Orthopedics)
documents.text:
Chief complaint: chronic right knee pain for 5 months.
History: Pain is worse on stairs and after prolonged walking. Pain limits stair climbing and walking more than 15 minutes. No locking or instability.
Examination: Medial joint line tenderness and a positive McMurray test on the right. Full range of motion.
Assessment: Chronic right knee pain, suspected medial meniscal tear.
Plan: Request MRI of the right knee without contrast.

documents.title: Physiotherapy discharge summary
documents.author: Physiotherapy department
documents.text:
Referral: right knee pain.
Completed 8 weeks of supervised physiotherapy (28 Jul to 22 Sep 2026) with minimal relief.
Program included quadriceps strengthening, hamstring stretching, and gait training.
Patient reports pain still interferes with her work as a schoolteacher.

documents.title: X-ray report, right knee
documents.author: Radiology department
documents.text:
Examination: X-ray of the right knee, weight-bearing AP and lateral views, performed on 20 Jul 2026.
Findings: Mild medial joint space narrowing. No fracture or effusion.
Impression: Early degenerative change, right knee.
